mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and metabolic effects may potentiate latanoprost's systemic cardiovascular and metabolic effects, while both drugs independently affect fluid/electrolyte balance and ocular hemodynamics.
action: Monitor serum potassium and electrolytes; assess for additive effects on blood pressure and heart rate; ensure adequate potassium intake or consider potassium-sparing agent if hypokalemia develops.
